title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
text:
Many schools ask students to wear uniforms. Supporters say that uniforms save time in the morning because everyone wears the same clothes. They also believe uniforms make students feel equal, so nobody is judged by expensive clothes. Some families, however, think school uniforms are too expensive.

I think uniforms are a good idea, but only if the price is reasonable. Students can focus on learning when they do not compare clothes with each other. Schools should also let students choose the color of their shoes or their bag. In this way, the uniform stays simple and everyone still feels free.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do supporters say uniforms save time?
options: Shops are closed in the morning.
Teachers choose the clothes for families.

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what does the writer think uniforms must be?
What is the writer's overall opinion about school uniforms?
options: They support uniforms with some conditions.
They have no opinion on uniforms.
They think uniforms should be expensive.

questions.text: Why does the writer want students to choose their shoes or bags?
options: To make the uniform feel less restrictive
To save money for the school
To compare clothes with other students

vocabulary.definition: special clothes that all students in a school wear
having the same rights or status as others
not too expensive, fair in price
to give all your attention to something

paragraph_translations: Багато шкіл просять учнів носити шкільну форму. Прихильники кажуть, що форма заощаджує час вранці, бо всі одягаються однаково. Вони також вважають, що форма робить учнів рівними, тож ніхто не оцінює людей за дорогим одягом. Проте деякі родини думають, що шкільна форма надто дорога.

Я вважаю, що форма — гарна ідея, але лише якщо її ціна доступна. Учні можуть зосередитися на навчанні, коли не порівнюють одяг один з одним. Школи також мають дозволяти учням вибирати колір взуття чи сумки. Так форма залишається простою, і всі відчувають себе вільними.
